posts.name: Rabit
posts.cooked:
For a variety of reasons, we decided to make things simpler this year: Everyone nominated will be getting a badge for the respective award! The new badges will go live... Uh, any time now. ![](upload://jmG3LQlF5SuLT7HrfVzYrp9QfUn.gif) (EDIT: Hey, look - new badges!)

Congratulations to everyone who was recognized for their contributions this past year, and thank you to all of you who have contributed to the community. Greater Than Games greatly appreciates everything you do here - and we Mods can't thank you enough for making our jobs simple and enjoyable. ![](upload://v8HPFTp4mIGfU9rdG54voZZlPnh.gif)

We won't be doing rolling nominations for awards next year, but we are going to look at other ways to help strengthen the community. We'll definitely be talking about it, soon!

 

2014 Forum Award Results

Unique Capabilities (Top Artist)

  • Sejixs (for her crossover art of Sentinels with Scott Pilgrim, SotM FF bots art-by-demand, and Siege-Breaker vs Cursed Acolyte)
  • Spiff (for his GSF minis)
  • svestus (for Sentinels of the Multiverse: The Movie)
  • UXM266 (for 8-bit Sentinels Part 1 and Part 2)

Exceeded Expectations (Top Contributor)

  • Powerhound_2000 (for contributions on the card spoilers sheet)
  • Spiff (for various things, including FAQs)

Harmony (Top Debator)

  • Foote (for various things, including contributions on the objectivity discussion)

Inspiring Presence (Morale Booster)

  • Arcanist Lupus (for various things, including extended and entertaining limerick posting)
  • Reckless (for various things, including comments in the gender discussion)

Truth Seeker (Lore Master)

  • Ronway

Bolster Allies (Funniest)

  • Silverleaf (for various things, including derailing threads)
  • Arcanist Lupus

 

Best Forum Activity

  • SotM Event #16: SotM Depth Chart
  • Waiting for Captain Cosmos

Best Fan Fiction of the Year

  • Date Night

Best Player Aid idea

  • Spiff's Tactics Accessories

Best Fan Art of the Year

  • DoomRoomba's Spite, K.N.Y.F.E., and Redeemer Fanatic

Funniest Thread of the Year

  • The "I have nothing real to contribute, but I am sick of seeing no new posts" thread
